data.title: US House Panel Advances Bitcoin Reserve Bill With 20-Year Holding Rule
data.description:
The US House Financial Services Committee has advanced a bill that would put the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into federal law and require the Treasury to hold Bitcoin deposited in it for at least 20 years from enactment.

The committee reported H.R. 8957, the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026, with amendments on November 24. The bill was placed on the House Union Calendar, a step that makes it eligible for floor consideration. It still needs to clear the House and Senate and be signed into law. Alaska Republican Rep. Nick Begich introduced the measure in May.

What Treasury could do with the reserve

The bill would direct qualifying Bitcoin already owned by the federal government into the reserve and qualifying non-Bitcoin assets into a separate Digital Asset Stockpile. Treasury would administer both. The bill says reserve assets could not be “sold, swapped, auctioned, encumbered, or otherwise disposed of” during the minimum holding period. The restriction starts on the date the law takes effect and applies to Bitcoin acquired by the US and deposited in the reserve, regardless of how the government obtained it.

Two years before the holding period ends, Treasury would have to recommend whether to keep holding the Bitcoin or allow a gradual release. Once the period expires, the secretary could recommend selling up to 10% of the reserve’s assets in any two-year period.

The bill separately gives Treasury a year from enactment to study when an early sale might be appropriate and recommend any changes to the law, including possible exceptions for national security or financial stability. That study would leave any decision to create an exception with Congress.

How it builds on the 2025 executive order

President Donald Trump established the reserve and stockpile by executive order in March 2025. The order used eligible forfeited Bitcoin as the basis for the reserve and directed the government to retain Bitcoin deposited in it. It also authorised Treasury and Commerce to develop strategies to acquire additional Bitcoin without imposing incremental costs on taxpayers.

The House bill would set the holding rule in statute and create reporting and public proof-of-reserves requirements. It would also give Treasury and Commerce 180 days to study whether the government could acquire more Bitcoin in a way that avoids increasing the national debt. The bill calls for a study and sets no purchase target or acquisition schedule. A separate proposal from Sen. Cynthia Lummis would authorise the government to acquire an additional one million Bitcoin.

The next step is a House floor vote. The Block reported that the approaching end of the 119th Congress leaves limited time for both chambers to act.

data.title: Japan's JERA enters talks with Anthropic, Meta to build data centres, Nikkei reports
data.description:
Japan's largest power generator, JERA, has entered into talks with Anthropic , Meta , and other US tech giants to build data centers near power plants in the Tokyo area, Nikkei newspaper reported on Friday.

JERA Global CEO and Chair Yukio Kani said in a recent interview that the energy group is also in discussions with Amazon , Microsoft and Google , Nikkei reported.

JERA announced a partnership with Dell Technologies and UK-based AI infrastructure developer RHAELM in October to accelerate the development of artificial intelligence infrastructure in Japan.

They signed a memorandum of understanding to develop a standardised model for building AI infrastructure on a national scale, starting with a $15 billion hyperscale data centre in Chiba, near Tokyo.

JERA, Anthropic, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft and Google did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment.

data.title: Aurania Announces Termination of Private Placement, Loan Agreement and Proposed Warrant Extension
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Aurania Resources Ltd. (OTCQB: AUIAF) (FSE: 20Q) ("Aurania" or the "Company") announces that it has (i) terminated its previously announced private placement, (ii) entered into a loan agreement with its Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, Dr. Keith Barron, and (iii) intends to extend the term of certain outstanding common share purchase warrants.

The Company has terminated its non-brokered private placement as announced by the Company on November 19, 2026, due to current market conditions.

Dr. Keith Barron has agreed to provide a loan of up to US$1,500,000 to the Company to be advanced from time to time in principal amounts as agreed by the parties (the "Loan"). The Loan is unsecured, bears interest at 2% per annum and matures twelve months and one day after demand for repayment is given by the Lender, which may be provided at any time following the date hereof. The proceeds of the Loan will be used for exploration expenses and general working capital.

Dr. Keith Barron is a related party of the Company by virtue of the fact that he is Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, a promoter and a principal shareholder of the Company, and as a result, each advance and repayment under the Loan constitutes a "Related Party Transaction" for the purposes of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101"). The Company is relying upon an exemption from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements under MI 61-101 in respect of the Related Party Transaction, in reliance on Sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1) of MI 61-101, respectively, as the fair market value of the Related Party Transaction, collectively, does not exceed 25% of the Company's market capitalization, as determined in accordance with MI 61-101. The Company did not file a material change report related to the Loan more than 21 days before the expected closing of the Loan as required by MI 61-101, as the Company wished to organize the Loan on an expedited basis for sound business reasons.

The Company further announces that it has applied to the TSX Venture Exchange (the "TSXV") to extend the expiry date of an aggregate of 3,747,243 common share purchase warrants of the Company (the "Warrants") issued pursuant to a non-brokered private placement of the Company (the "Offering"), which closed in tranches on December 13, 2024, and December 23, 2024. Each Warrant is exercisable at a price of C$0.75, with 2,726,499 Warrants expiring on December 13, 2026, and 1,020,744 Warrants expiring on December 23, 2026. The Company intends to extend the expiry date for these Warrants by 12 months to December 13, 2027, and December 23, 2027, respectively for each tranche of Warrants. All other terms and conditions of the Warrants will remain unchanged. The extension of the expiry date of the Warrants is subject to the acceptance of the TSXV.

Dr. Keith Barron participated in the Offering (subscribing through Bambazonke Holdings Ltd., a wholly-owned company of Dr. Barron) and accordingly was issued 888,889 of the Warrants, all of which Dr. Barron continues to hold (the "Insider Warrants"). Dr. Barron's ownership of the Insider Warrants renders the Warrant expiry date extension a "related party transaction" within the meaning of MI 61-101. However, the extension is exempt from the requirements of Part 5 of MI 61-101 pursuant to Sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1) of MI 61-101 as the fair market value of Dr. Keith Barron's interest in the extension does not exceed 25% of the Company's market capitalization, as determined in accordance with MI 61-101.

The Loan and the Warrant extension were approved by the members of the board of directors of the Company who are independent for purposes of the related party transactions, being all directors other than Dr. Barron. No special committee was established in connection with the Loan or Warrant extension, and no materially contrary view or abstention was expressed or made by any director of the Company in relation thereto.

About Aurania

Aurania is a mineral exploration company engaged in the identification, evaluation, acquisition, and exploration of mineral property interests, with a focus on precious metals and critical energy in Europe and abroad.

Information on Aurania and technical reports are available at www.aurania.com and www.sedarplus.ca, as well as on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/auranialtd/, Twitter at https://twitter.com/auranialtd, and LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/company/aurania-resources-ltd-.

Co-founded by TSX, alongside five other national organizations, CCWX demonstrates how market infrastructure providers can mobilize capital markets to tackle climate challenges. Given TSX's central position within Canada's capital markets, stock exchanges are uniquely positioned to foster broad stakeholder engagement, and advance a national conversation on climate-aligned action and initiatives.

data.title: Eshbal Reports Nine-Month 2026 Revenue of US$12.1 Million, Up 19.5% Year-Over-Year
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 26, 2026) - Eshbal Functional Food Inc. ("Eshbal" or the "Company") reports its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. All amounts are in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated.

Cannot view this image? Visit:

https://images.newsfilecorp.com/files/12370/326023_ef8ef79ef4aaa91f_logo.jpg

Eshbal reported revenue of US$12.07 million for the first nine months of 2026, an increase of 19.5% compared with US$10.10 million for the same period in 2025. For the third quarter of 2026, revenue was US$3.31 million, compared with US$3.38 million in Q3 2025.

The year-over-year comparison reflects the continued evolution of Eshbal following completion of its reverse takeover in April 2025. Accordingly, the first four months of the 2025 comparative period primarily reflected Eshbal's operations prior to completion of the RTO and did not include the Company's current public-company cost structure and the launch of its North American operations.

Financial Highlights

  • Nine-month revenue of US$12.07 million, up 19.5% from US$10.10 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
  • Third-quarter revenue of US$3.31 million, compared to US$3.38 million for the third quarter of 2025.
  • Gross margin of 21.5% for the nine months (16.0% for the third quarter), compared to 26.9% (29.5%) for the comparable periods of 2025, mainly reflecting changes in product mix and lower sales in Israel.
  • Third-quarter net loss of US$0.94 million, compared to US$0.51 million for the third quarter of 2025.
  • Net loss for the nine months of US$1.66 million, compared to US$2.11 million for the comparable period.
  • Total assets of US$14.21 million as at September 30, 2026, compared to US$12.24 million as at December 31, 2025.

Operational Highlights

  • North America: In September 2026, Eshbal USA, which includes the Gluten Free Nation business, participated in the ECRM trade show, meeting with approximately 40 potential retail and foodservice customers. Following the show, the Company sent product samples to approximately 20 prospective customers and is in follow-up discussions with them.
  • Gluten-free Pita: The Company continued supplying its gluten-free Pita products from its Ontario manufacturing partners and continued discussions with leading Canadian retailers.
  • Product development: The Company developed initial samples of a powdered protein shake product designed for GLP-1 medication users.

"Over the past nine months, our focus has been on integrating our recently acquired businesses, addressing operational and commercial challenges, strengthening relationships with suppliers and customers, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and create synergies across the Group," said Tomer Bar Meir, Chief Executive Officer of Eshbal. "While these efforts take time to translate into financial results, we expect to see the benefits of this work increasingly reflected in our performance during 2027."

Board Update

The Company also announces that Nir Peles has been appointed Vice-Chair of the Board of Directors and a member of the Audit Committee, replacing Yuval Levy on the Audit Committee. The Audit Committee is now composed of Sokhie Puar (Chair), Tamir Dagan, Ifti Ifhar and Nir Peles.

"I am pleased to take on the role of Vice-Chair and to join the Audit Committee," said Nir Peles. "I look forward to working with the Board and management to support Eshbal's continued growth."

The Company's condensed interim consolidated financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 are available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

About Eshbal Group

Eshbal Group is an international food group focused on developing, manufacturing, and commercializing better-for-you, gluten-free, GLP-1 friendly food products and dietary supplements. Built on more than three decades of industry experience, the Group combines product innovation, manufacturing expertise, and commercial expertise to develop and grow a portfolio of innovative health and wellness brands. The Group's strategy is to build a leading platform of health and wellness brands through organic growth, strategic acquisitions, operational excellence, and international expansion.
